gloss: to drag in; to pull in (physically)

definitions.gloss: to drag in; to pull in (physically)
definitions.explanation: to forcefully pull or drag something or someone into a place

definitions.gloss: to drag into; to draw into (figuratively)
definitions.explanation: to involve someone in a situation, conflict, or trouble, often against their will

examples.english: I dragged the heavy luggage into the room.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{引|ひ}きずる→引きずる：06045_hikizuru⟧ (to drag) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The literal sense describes physical dragging, while the figurative sense describes being pulled into unwanted situations.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive equivalent would be a passive construction: {引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}まれる (to be dragged into).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}む: to drag A into B
- {引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}まれる: to be dragged in (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}む: to drag into a dispute
- ⟦{泥沼|どろぬま}→泥沼：11065_doronuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}む: to drag into a quagmire
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}む: to drag into crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to involve, to drag in — more general; can be accidental involvement
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む→引き込む：05736_hikikomu⟧: to pull in, to lure in — less forceful than {引|ひ}きずり{込|こ}む
- ⟦{引|ひ}きずる→引きずる：06045_hikizuru⟧: to drag — the base verb, without the "into" direction
